translations.topbar.source.tooltip: Remote folder to scan (session folders are searched up to 4 levels below it)
translations.topbar.scan.tooltip: Scan the remote folder (F5). Nothing is downloaded.
translations.dialog.destination.title: Choose destination folder (frames go to <folder>/<OBJECT>/subs)
translations.dialog.destination_required.title: Destination folder
translations.dialog.destination_required.text:
Choose where frames should be saved first.
They go to <folder>/<OBJECT>/subs/.
translations.dialog.quit.title: Quit SubPull
translations.dialog.quit.text:
Downloads are running. Stop them and quit?
Partial files are kept so the downloads can resume.
translations.library.unrecognized.tooltip: Files and folders that cannot be assigned to an object
translations.library.details.tooltip: Show or hide the details panel
translations.library.banner.text: No destination folder set – choose where frames are saved before downloading.
translations.library.empty.title: No scan yet
translations.library.empty.text: Pick an SFTP site and a remote folder in the toolbar, then press Scan. Nothing is scanned or downloaded until you ask for it.
translations.library.objects.title: Objects
translations.library.group.label: Group
translations.library.types.label: Types
translations.library.new_only.tooltip: Hide frames that are already in your library
translations.library.columns.title: Columns
translations.library.read_headers.tooltip: Read OBJECT / IMAGETYP / FILTER / EXPTIME for the selected files (only the header blocks are transferred)
translations.details.placeholder: Select a frame to see its details.
translations.status.detail.same_name: another scanned file has the same name for this object
translations.queue.stop_all.tooltip: Stop every transfer; partial files are kept for resume
translations.queue.retry_failed.tooltip: Re-queue failed and cancelled transfers (they resume)
translations.queue.clear_finished.tooltip: Remove finished rows from this list (files are kept)
translations.queue.empty.title: No transfers
translations.queue.empty.text: Select frames in the Library and press Download. Transfers start only after you confirm the selection.
translations.history.downloads.title: Downloaded files
translations.history.activity.title: Activity
translations.history.activity.subtitle: Scans, download batches and transfer errors.
translations.settings.language.title: Language
translations.settings.language.subtitle: The interface language changes immediately. Translations are bundled with SubPull and made by the community.
translations.settings.language.label: Language
translations.settings.language.help.tooltip: Opens the translation guide on GitHub in your browser
translations.settings.connection.title: Connection
translations.settings.connection.subtitle: SubPull reuses the sites saved in FileZilla's Site Manager (read-only) and the host keys FileZilla already trusts. Passwords and keys are never shown.  Source: {path}
translations.settings.connection.idle: Not connected – SubPull connects only when you scan or test.
translations.settings.library.title: Library
translations.settings.library.subtitle: Every frame type goes straight into the object's subs folder. Original names are kept, existing files are never overwritten without your confirmation.
translations.settings.scanning.title: Scanning
translations.settings.scanning.subtitle: Scans run only when you press Scan. Session folders (YYYY-MM-DD) are searched up to four levels below the remote folder.
translations.settings.scanning.read_fits: Read every FITS header while scanning
translations.settings.scanning.read_fits.tooltip: Verifies object, frame type and filter against the header. Headers of files without an object folder are always read.
translations.settings.scanning.placeholders.tooltip: Comma-separated OBJECT values that mean 'no object' (case-insensitive)
translations.settings.transfers.title: Transfers
translations.settings.transfers.subtitle: Downloads start only after you confirm them.
translations.settings.transfers.verification.text: Size check after every file; server SHA-256 when the server supports the SFTP check-file extension.
translations.settings.transfers.interrupted.text: Kept as *{suffix} and resumed on the next download.
translations.settings.data.title: Data
translations.settings.data.subtitle: History, settings and the log live here – never inside your frame folders.
translations.confirm.title: Review download
translations.confirm.handled.title: Files already handled
translations.confirm.handled.text: By default SubPull skips files that are already in your library or in the download history.
translations.confirm.option.present: Download again files already in the library (same size) – overwrites them
translations.confirm.option.conflict: Replace local files whose size differs – overwrites them
translations.confirm.option.history_only: Download again files from history that are no longer on disk

confirm.clash.one: {count} file is skipped: another scanned file has the same name for that object, or the name is not valid as a file name. Names are never changed automatically.
confirm.clash.other: {count} files are skipped: another scanned file has the same name for that object, or the name is not valid as a file name. Names are never changed automatically.

translations.confirm.overwrite.title: Overwrite files

confirm.overwrite.text.one:
{count} file that already exists in your library will be replaced by the server version.

Continue?
confirm.overwrite.text.other:
{count} files that already exist in your library will be replaced by the server version.

Continue?

translations.unrecognized.text: These files have no unambiguous object (for example OBJECT = 'Target' in a folder without an object name) or are folders that are not frame types. SubPull never downloads them, so nothing ends up in a random folder.
translations.unrecognized.reason.not_frame_type: subdirectory '{name}' is not a frame type – skipped
translations.unrecognized.reason.no_object: no object directory and no FITS OBJECT keyword
translations.hostkey.mismatch.title: Host key mismatch
translations.hostkey.mismatch.text: The server identifies itself with a different key than the one FileZilla trusts. The connection was blocked. Check the server in FileZilla before continuing.
translations.hostkey.unknown.title: Unknown host key
translations.hostkey.unknown.text: This key is not stored in FileZilla or known_hosts. Trust it for this session only? (Nothing is saved.)
translations.error.connection.title: Connection problem
translations.error.hostkey.mismatch: Host key of {host} does NOT match the trusted key! ({fingerprint})
translations.error.auth.no_keyfile: Site '{site}' does not specify a key file.
translations.error.auth.key_unusable: Cannot use the site's key file (or any SSH agent key).
translations.error.auth.no_credentials: Site '{site}' has no saved credentials usable without prompting (use a key file or a saved password).
translations.error.site.protocol: Site '{site}' uses {protocol}; only SFTP is supported.
translations.error.site.none: No SFTP site in FileZilla Site Manager – create one there first.
translations.error.site.no_sitemanager: {path} not found – no FileZilla Site Manager entries.
translations.error.download.truncated: Server stopped sending before the end of the file
translations.error.download.changed: The server file changed during download – download it again
translations.error.download.sha_mismatch: SHA-256 does not match the server – partial file removed, download again
translations.error.name.invalid_object: Object name '{name}' is not a valid folder/file name – skipped (names are never changed)
translations.error.name.invalid_file: File name '{name}' is not a valid folder/file name – skipped (names are never changed)
